_doc: Source waypoints for the Apollo 17 powered-descent reference track. Times are ALSJ-clock GET 'h:mm:ss' (ALSJ clock = Mission Report clock + 2:40:00). Every row carries provenance: V = verified table/text value read in this session, R = read second-hand (search summary / fetched summary, not re-checked in the original), E = estimated/interpolated (method in note). unc = 1-sigma-ish band, same unit as the value (time bands in s).

clock.ignition_note: Mission Report (JSC-07904 table 8-VI) ignition 110:09:53 = 112:49:53 ALSJ clock. ALSJ text says 112:49:56 (3 s later); unresolved, MR used because contact 113:01:58 matches MR 110:21:58 and MR lists ignition-to-landing 12:05 = 725 s.

altitude_ft.note: PDI: 8.7 nmi (16.1 km) above the reference sphere + 2.626 km site elevation; NOT a direct table value

altitude_ft.src: MR 8.5: radar velocity acquired at about 42,000 ft before the yaw (yaw at 112:54:07 ALSJ; time est)

MR 10.7: pitchover 'at about 7500 feet'; MR P64 selected 112:59:15 (ALSJ says pitchover 112:59:18). The MR time keeps the descent rate 175 to 182 fps across 11,000 / 7,500 / 5,500 ft; the ALSJ time would need 250 fps
ALSJ: through 1,000 ft, 800 ft at about 113:00:20
ALSJ 'a little dust' at 80 ft (other lines say 90/60 ft; MR: dust first seen at 60 to 70 ft on the tape meter)

rates_check_fps.note: time between the 500 and 300 ft calls, est

pitch_deg.src: ALSJ: measured in the landing-site frame, 0 = vertical (thrust axis)
pitchover starts; ALSJ 60 deg to about 20 deg from vertical

yaw_left_deg.src: ALSJ / MR: yaw 290 deg (= 70 left) before ignition
MR 10.7: yawed 290 -> 340 at 4 min with landing-radar lock
ALSJ: yaw to zero at 112:56:33 for windows up; duration est 17 s

events.ev: ignition, DPS at minimum throttle (10 percent)

events.src: MR table 8-VI 110:11:25 (its T+ column reads 00:32, an OCR/misprint; 110:11:25 - 110:09:53 = 1:32). ALSJ puts the Houston call at 112:51:03 (T+1:07 on its clock); text says about 2 min in

events.ev: P66 landing phase (manual attitude/rate, just under 300 ft per MR)

events.src: MR: total firing about 727 s => 2 s after contact; ALSJ has engine stop about 113:02:03 (5 s). Band +2..+5 s.

dust.src: ALSJ call altitude; time est between 200 ft@113:00:55 and 80 ft@113:01:15

dust.what: 'getting a little dust' (ALSJ table); MR: first observed at 60 to 70 ft on the tape meter
dust becomes easily visible in the film (ALSJ commentary at about 113:01:38)
dust.prov: V for the film time, E for the height

dust.what: contact light; MR: landing radar had no lock-up on moving dust

targets.offset_alsj_text: planned point about 230 m west and about 60 m south of the actual landing site, as fetched (direction wording ambiguous in the fetch summary, not re-read in the original)
targets.offset_caller_brief: LM landed about 230 m W / 60 m S of the target; the Mission Report says 'several hundred meters south' after the redesignations
targets.final_attitude: 4 to 5 deg pitch up, roll about 2 deg left (MR 10.7 and ALSJ), rear strut in a 3 to 4 m crater

geometry_reads.what: about 40 miles east of the site (ALSJ)
5 miles east of the site (ALSJ commentary)
PDI about 18 degrees of longitude east of the site (ALSJ commentary)
